_meta.notes: Net agri-food trade balance per country in millions USD. Positive = net exporter, negative = net importer. 'Food, Total' aggregate preferred; 'Agricultural Products, Total' used as fallback. Matching is name-first (code-tolerant) to survive FAOSTAT item-code drift. Covered 185 of 180 mapped countries. Most-recent year per country where both export and import values are populated and not flagged as missing.
